svg.aria-label: Oxidation number, oxidation/reduction and agents symbolic bridge
svg.title: Oxidation number, oxidation/reduction and agents symbolic bridge
svg.desc: For Oxidation number, oxidation/reduction and agents, the displayed symbols mean: An increase in formal oxidation number tracks oxidation and a decrease tracks reduction; agent names describe the process caused in the partner. The diagram is a symbolic teaching representation and does not add unstated charge, phase, coefficient, or mechanism claims.
